values.summary: Consume the passing WP-22 matrix, inventory canonical docs and claims, classify stale/planned/blocked/unsupported truth, make narrow evidence-linked corrections, validate links/formats/commands/non-claims, and complete exact-head docs review.

steps.action: Verify the passing WP-22 matrix is terminal and ancestral; pin the docs-review evidence base.
Inventory canonical root, milestone, feature, ADR, release, skill, and agent-guidance claims and ownership.
Classify current/stale/planned/blocked/unsupported/historical statements and apply narrow evidence-linked corrections.
Build docs-review and justified ADR-candidate packets; validate formats, links, commands, versions, ownership, evidence, and non-claims.
Resolve exact-head docs review and publish the closing PR without review or ceremony authority.

affected_areas: README.md and CHANGELOG.md only where canonical v0.92 truth requires correction
Exact inventoried files under docs/milestones/v0.92, active feature lists, skills, and nested AGENTS.md
invariants: No scope absorption across work packages
Evidence claims remain exact-revision and source-grounded
stop_conditions: Required proof cannot be produced within issue scope
